v42851f3b.text: Your Proof File shows your finished MC1 work. Your assessor checks this file. You make it in 3 steps. Your task. Tap each card to see what you do.

vf5c1f0ac.text: Attach your 6 pieces of work. This is a practice form, so you type a file name. Each piece of work shows the types of file you can use. Your task. Type a file name for each piece of work and tap Attach.

vba63d2c2.text: Your work is safe if the internet stops. In the real form, your work saves as you go. Nothing is lost if the internet stops. Your task. Stop the internet, then start it again.

v1252e0c8.text: Check your Proof File before you submit. Look at each file name. Tap Change if a file is wrong. Your task. Choose the type of submission and tick the declaration.

va2d28fd4.text: Submit your Proof File for review. Your assessor checks your files. You get a receipt after you submit. Your task. Tap Submit my Proof File.

v65dc3a69.text: Your Proof File is submitted. Your assessor will now review it. Keep your receipt as proof. Your task. Tap Download my receipt to keep a copy.
